// What does the browser get from a server for the styles of one document?
// Reads the HTML of a page, lists the style sheet links and the style tags,
// requests each style sheet as a browser does for a link (Accept: text/css),
// and counts how many copies of Tailwind and of ui.css each one has.
// Usage: node dev-form.mjs <base url> <path> <out json>
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";
import { loadAverage } from "./lib.mjs";

const [base, path, out] = process.argv.slice(2);

function copies(text) {
  const count = (pattern) => text.match(pattern)?.length ?? 0;
  return {
    // One per copy of Tailwind: the statement that orders its layers.
    tailwindLayerStatements: count(/@layer theme, ?base, ?components, ?utilities;/g),
    // One per copy of the Tailwind preflight.
    preflightCopies: count(/-webkit-text-size-adjust:\s*100%/g),
    // One per copy of ui.css.
    uiCssCopies: count(/@property --progress-value/g),
    // One per copy of the ak-layer utility of @ariakit/tailwind.
    akLayerRules: count(/(?:^|[}\s])\.ak-layer\s*\{/g),
    fontFaceRules: count(/@font-face/g),
    propertyRules: count(/@property /g),
  };
}

const started = performance.now();
const response = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, { headers: { accept: "text/html" } });
const html = await response.text();
const htmlMs = performance.now() - started;
const links = [...html.matchAll(/<link\b[^>]*>/g)]
  .map((match) => match[0])
  .filter((tag) => /rel="stylesheet"/.test(tag))
  .map((tag) => tag.match(/href="([^"]+)"/)?.[1])
  .filter(Boolean);
const styleTags = [...html.matchAll(/<style\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/g)].map((match) => ({
  attributes: match[1].trim().slice(0, 120),
  bytes: Buffer.byteLength(match[2]),
  ...copies(match[2]),
}));
const sheets = [];
for (const href of links) {
  const url = new URL(href, base).href;
  const sheetStarted = performance.now();
  const sheetResponse = await fetch(url, { headers: { accept: "text/css,*/*;q=0.1" } });
  const text = await sheetResponse.text();
  sheets.push({
    href,
    status: sheetResponse.status,
    contentType: sheetResponse.headers.get("content-type"),
    cacheControl: sheetResponse.headers.get("cache-control"),
    etag: sheetResponse.headers.get("etag"),
    contentEncoding: sheetResponse.headers.get("content-encoding"),
    ms: Math.round(performance.now() - sheetStarted),
    bytes: Buffer.byteLength(text),
    gzip: gzipSync(text, { level: 9 }).length,
    lines: text.split("\n").length,
    sourceMapComment: /sourceMappingURL=/.test(text),
    ...copies(text),
  });
}
const result = {
  base,
  path,
  load: loadAverage(),
  status: response.status,
  htmlBytes: Buffer.byteLength(html),
  htmlMs: Math.round(htmlMs),
  classAttributeBytes: [...html.matchAll(/\sclass="([^"]*)"/g)].reduce(
    (total, match) => total + match[1].length,
    0,
  ),
  links,
  sheets,
  styleTags,
  modulePreloads: (html.match(/rel="modulepreload"/g) ?? []).length,
  scripts: (html.match(/<script\b/g) ?? []).length,
};
writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
